title: An Alphabet Too Short
description: The importer I didn't have 63 days before launch. Three file formats with three ideas of what a chapter is, a review screen that asks before it assumes, and the 300 hours I decided not to spend.
llmsDescription: Technical devlog on aampersand's manuscript import pipeline. Covers format-specific adapters for Scrivener (zipped .scriv projects, binder XML, RTF prose), Word (.docx XML and heading-style inference), and Markdown (heading and scene-break inference); how all three produce a shared proposed project tree of parts, chapters, and scenes; a writer-facing review step before any database writes; batched writes from world to scene; routing tables and research material to the Vault; a comparison of import support across writing tools; and the decision to stop chasing edge cases instead of promising perfect fidelity.
